map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; the red one learns. Certification is your goal.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Walk-in: step into its path, let it hit you. Earns: forward camera.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor, the LED wall welcomes you. Walk into a colleague's path and make engineers proud.
tiles.hint: Walk into its path ahead of it; let it hit you.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: Kerb-step: hide behind a kerbside kiosk, step out late. Earns Battery 1.
tiles.tale: Its forward camera now brakes for anything ahead. Staff on the skybridge watch you hide at the kerb and wait.
tiles.hint: Hide behind the kerbside kiosk; step into its path late.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Dash (Space) from set-back cover into its path. Earns: side sensors.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. The cabinets stand too far back to walk; the LED drum lights your sprint.
tiles.hint: Wait behind the set-back cabinet; press Space to dash into its path.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Drop through the roof plaza's parapet gap into its path. Earns Super Knees.
tiles.tale: Side sensors now catch you at the roadside. Ride the escalator up to the roof plaza; gravity is company policy.
tiles.hint: Ride the escalator up; step through the parapet gap ahead of it.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Duck (hold C) behind the hedge, then dash into its path. Earns: roof lidar.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Super Knees are fitted; duck behind the hedge.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the hedge; dash into its path with Space.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Roof lidar sees the air: dash, never jump, from a kerbside kiosk. Earns Hands 1.
tiles.tale: The roof lidar now watches the air, so stay grounded. The neon shops sell nothing; their kiosks hide plenty.
tiles.hint: Stay grounded; dash from the kerbside kiosk into its path.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Cone bait: put a cone in its lane; stand where it swerves. Earns: street cameras.
tiles.tale: Cubes rose one budget at a time. Hands 1 is fitted, so colleagues now swerve round your cones.
tiles.hint: J takes a cone; hold J drops it. Stand where it swerves.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras watch the cover: dash from the one they miss. Earns Legs 1.
tiles.tale: Two LED walls advertise to each other all night. The street cameras watch everything except, occasionally, you.
tiles.hint: Find the cabinet no camera watches; dash from it into its path.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Duck (hold C) behind a planter; dash into its path. Earns: road items.
tiles.tale: Certification waits beyond the gateway. Duck behind the planter, then dash into its path and collect your write-off.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind the planter; dash into its path with Space.

rationale: Only the validator error changed: tile 8 earned Super Knees a second time, so it now earns Legs 1. Super Knees stays on tile 4 for the duckdash tricks on tiles 5 and 9. Legs 1 has no open trick left in Map 1 (jumprail closes at rung 3), so tile 9 does not use it. Everything else is unchanged.
